events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has shown the military strength of the US, but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict is expected to continue, with potential implications for global markets. The US has demonstrated its military capabilities, but the war has also highlighted the complexities of modern warfare.
events.reasoning: The ongoing conflict in Iran is likely to lead to increased volatility in oil prices, making the Invesco DB Oil Fund (DBO) a potential buy. On the other hand, emerging markets may be negatively impacted by the war, making the iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF (EEM) a potential short.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil price movements and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or the conflict de-escalates
